name: Ego4D
description: Egocentric video dataset comprising about 3,670 hours of video from 931 wearers. Research license; loader-only, with no data vendored.
citation: Grauman et al. (2022). Ego4D: Around the World in 3,000 Hours of Egocentric Video. Proceedings of the IEEE/CVF Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition (CVPR).
